summary: Universal Electronics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its Q2 2026 financial results and a management transition. Interim CEO and COO Richard K. Carnifax resigned effective August 6, 2026, prompting the Board to appoint Wade M. Jenke as CEO and President, Sui Man Ho as CFO, and Joseph (Lee) Haughawout as COO, effective the same date. Jenke's base salary was increased from $325,000 to $355,000 with a target bonus of 40%. The changes appear voluntary and structured, with no disclosed strategic rationale or external catalyst. Watch for future operational updates or potential strategic initiatives under the new leadership.
